# scripts/Showcase/ShowOverlay.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Showcase/ShowOverlay.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Showcase subtitles, alert/mercy marks, act titles, actor names, and ending/speed messages.
Shows up to three nearby visible speakers; letterboxed drama places subtitles in the lower bar.
Real-time fades follow the camera clock; H toggles the overlay.

Base: `CanvasLayer`. Registered class: `none`.
